name: @forgeax/engine-audio
description: Realm-neutral ForgeaX audio: ECS components, tick/plugin, backend protocol, POD clips, and closed Host intent transport.

bundle-size.reason: runtime tick and intent producer are covered by package build/tests; no standalone player bundle is emitted

fps.reason: realm-neutral package has no canvas; frame impact is measured by consuming apps

bench.reason: intent production is linear in changed sources; end-to-end cost is measured by the multithreaded execution app

gate.reason: no package-level binary gate; test surface coverage runs as part of pnpm test:unit + tsc -b

spike-report.reason: not a spike package; this is a production MVP per plan-strategy D-1 (dual-package split)
